issues.title: Incorrect table reference
issues.problem: The query references a table 'students' which does not exist in the provided schema.

issues.title: Missing ORDER BY clause
issues.problem: Without an 'ORDER BY' clause, the database does not guarantee which 5 records are returned; the results could change every time you run it.
issues.fix: SELECT merchant_name FROM sigma_analytics.dim_merchant ORDER BY merchant_name LIMIT 5;

issues.title: Ambiguous column alias
issues.problem: The column alias 'name' is ambiguous and does not match the schema.

review.corrected_sql: SELECT merchant_name FROM sigma_analytics.dim_merchant ORDER BY merchant_name LIMIT 5;
review.summary: The query had incorrect table references, lacked an ORDER BY clause, and used an ambiguous column alias.
